ad_library.summary: D'LIFE is the only lead in this batch that is advertising on both platforms at scale: five active Meta ads read today (the oldest running since 13 May 2026) and roughly 200 live Google ads under the verified advertiser 'D'LIFE Interiors Private Limited'. The spend is national while the page we audited is Hyderabad-specific, and the mismatch shows: the ads quote a Delhi phone number (+91 9567231111) on a page that publishes +91 949 508 7777, and every Meta ad opens a Messenger chat rather than the site. The page does measure: a Meta Pixel (215010909028561) and a Google Tag Manager container (GTM-K9FB6G2) are both in the served HTML, behind Cloudflare Zaraz and NitroPack - but nothing in the markup tells either of them which ad produced a lead, and GA4 and the Google Ads conversion id exist only inside that container. What is measurable is the markup: 148 validator errors, including 64 telephone links with unencoded spaces that will not dial on some Android handsets.

scope_note: Re-read on 2026-11-28 through the W3C checker's source view. Present in the served HTML: Google Tag Manager GTM-K9FB6G2 (head), Meta Pixel 215010909028561 (noscript image at the top of the body), Cloudflare Zaraz, the server-side tag runner (/cdn-cgi/zaraz/s.js) and the Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon. The enquiry form is a real Contact Form 7 form (form_id 40457, Name field, conditional-logic add-on, reCAPTCHA response field), not just a JavaScript modal. GA4 and Google Ads conversion ids do not appear in the HTML at all - with GTM-K9FB6G2 and Zaraz both running, they are loaded from inside those containers, which no page read can open, so those rows stay unchecked instead of being called missing. The document is 3,984 lines with a 300 KB inline stylesheet ahead of the head metadata, so the meta description and Open Graph tags were read separately, through Microlink's headless fetch of the same URL on the same day (description 157 characters, og:image Interior_designers_in_hyderabad_web.jpg 1920x670, and the response header x-nitro-cache: MISS confirming the NitroPack layer); JSON-LD and the favicon remain unread.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
